subtitle: A compact model of refraction, reflection, and color separation
audience: a beginner who may not be fluent in English
objectives: Explain why sunlight separates into colors inside a raindrop
Describe why the primary rainbow appears opposite the Sun

terminology.definition: A change in a wave's direction caused by entering a medium where it travels at a different speed.

sections.title: Light takes three steps
sections.summary: A raindrop bends incoming light, reflects it internally, and bends it again as it exits.

points.text: Different wavelengths bend by slightly different amounts, spreading white light into visible colors.

sections.deep_dive: Each observer sees light from a different set of drops, so a rainbow is not a fixed object at one location.

terms.definition: A change in a wave's direction caused by entering a medium where it travels at a different speed.

knowledge_check.question: Why do the colors separate?
knowledge_check.answer: The drop refracts different wavelengths by slightly different amounts.
